shape.text: The user-tokens API page publishes a full example whose segments measure exactly 14 and 67. A token is 14 alphanumeric characters, the literal marker .atlasv1., then 67 alphanumeric characters, 90 characters in all. No checksum or other marker is documented beyond the .atlasv1. version tag.

Two scanner rules corroborate the family but disagree on width: one uses a looser tail of 60 to 70 characters over a wider alphabet, and the other uses the exact 14 and 67 widths. A tail of 60 to 66 characters is accepted by the looser rule and not by the exact one.
